QuestInfo.name: [Heliseum] Securing the Center 2
QuestInfo.1: Tiron thinks the Specters are being made somewhere. He wants you to wipe out about #r30 Specter Engineers#k.
QuestInfo.2: Unfortunately, the scouting showed that no Nova remained in Heliseum. It seems those that couldn't seek refuge in Pantheon lost their lives.

0.0: Wow, even this place is filled with Specters. How many Specters did they mobilize? Gerand Darmoor has an incredible force at his disposal. #rIt's like he can just make them on command.#k

yes.0: This is not the time! Please wipe out about #r30 Specter Engineers#k. I'll be checking the area.

1.0: The Specters are pulling back. Thank you very much!

yes.0: I was trying to find any Nova remaining in Heliseum...but I didn't see anyone. I guess it's obvious with this place filled with Specters... It seems #rthose that didn't seek refuge in Pantheon lost their lives#k.
yes.1: Shall we continue securing these areas? Let's move on to the next.
